mail_content:
${!Events.Who_Id.First_Name},


I enjoyed meeting with you during your Legal Life Planning Session! I highly encourage you to proceed with planning, even if you choose to do so with another lawyer.


I do caution you against working with a lawyer (or document service) who will provide you with just a set of estate planning documents that, in many cases, are unlikely to work as you intend.


As you know, planning for your family and estate addresses so much more than just the passage of your financial wealth; it ensures your most valuable and most often lost assets are passed on to your loved ones after you are gone – your intellectual, spiritual, and human assets. It also keeps your family out of conflict, and out of court, when something happens to you and ensures none of your assets are lost to the State Department of Unclaimed Property. 

When you are working with our team, you can rest easy knowing you have a trusted personal lawyer to turn to before making important financial and legal decisions for you and your family throughout life and that your loved ones will be able to turn to us for support after you are gone.


This kind of support and care is the reason you want to take care of this vital legal life planning now.


Please do not just rely on a set of form documents or a lawyer who provides a one-off transaction.


Remember, your estate plan is not merely a set of documents that you execute once, stick on a shelf and never look at again. Your plan is a living set of documents that changes with you over time as your life changes, your assets change, and the law changes.
